title: Heavenly Roasted Egyptian Date Toast
description: A rich and velvety Egyptian dish featuring roasted dates, cocoa, and toast, perfect for a date night, and is dairy-free friendly, served in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the pitted dates on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 15 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cocoa powder, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whip the coconut cream until it becomes stiff peaks.
Spread a layer of almond butter on each toasted bread slice.
Top the almond butter with a roasted date and a dollop of whipped coconut cream.
Drizzle the cocoa mixture over the top of each slice.
Sprinkle a pinch of sea salt over the top of each slice.
Serve immediately in a bento box.
